ratings_why.fun: Choosing where news starts and watching it ripple out is a satisfying puzzle, and Gundel turns feel like the whole council laughing at once; the step-and-halving math is the cost.
ratings_why.distinct: A gain that spreads and shrinks along tied bodies is fresh, but it sits close to Hedgerow's touching-run growth, so it's not a clean break from today's tribes.

verdict_why: The v3 Knot and tie rules now read correctly; what's left is wording polish and a reach preview in the UI, not a design fix.

points.text: Little Fips' +1/+1 never leaves him, so in the middle his card says Gossip but nothing spreads. A middle value of +2/+1 would always reach a neighbour and still teach that ends are better.

Tie says it counts as touching 'for every card's text', but the Knot says a tie adds only the tied unit, while Hedgerow runs get extended by ties. Put the Knot exception into Tie's own text so a player reads it in one place.

Attack and Health halve separately, so +2/+1 reaches one step with Attack only. That's correct but hard to see at a glance; the reach preview the risks call for should show Attack and Health reach apart.

The Winter Huddle's text is four rules sentences. Something like 'Hits on your Knot are shared with the units touching the target' plus a reminder tooltip would read faster and feel more like a huddle.

standouts.why: The Seconder hears a motion and repeats it: the council joke and the mechanic are the same thing, and it's readable.
Old Gundel's tickle makes everyone gossip at once; one short line, a huge visible turn, and pure folklore.
Ilse reading back the biggest news is the minute-taker made literal, and a clear late-game decision about what to make biggest.

weakest.why: In the middle of the Knot his Gossip reaches nobody, so the first Rat a player sees looks like it doesn't do its keyword.
The longest text in the tribe and the hardest to read; the huddle fantasy gets lost in the share rules.
Selling a neighbour for news is fine but generic; little of the council or knot comes through.

flags.note: Each share is a hit, so Bristle and Damage Reduction apply per share; worth testing against Bog folk.
With Mill-Chimney and the Rattenkönig, a 40/40 biggest unit gives every Knot unit +40/+40 in a fight.
Next to an Ooze that eats a big unit, one Eat becomes a very large piece of news, and Ilse can repeat it.
